tool_input.command: for f in README.md index.html package.json pigment.app.json src/App.tsx src/main.tsx src/components/*.tsx src/pages/*.tsx src/data/*.ts src/styles/base.css tests/smoke.spec.ts vite.config.ts; do echo "=== $f"; cat "$f"; done; ls; cat .gitignore

git checkout -b night-cartridge-restyle && mkdir -p src/art design-system && cp design-packages/night-cartridge-1.2.0-rc.9/dist/tokens.css src/styles/tokens.css && cp design-packages/night-cartridge-1.2.0-rc.9/dist/tokens.css design-packages/night-cartridge-1.2.0-rc.9/dist/tokens.json design-system/ && sed -n 1,40p design-packages/night-cartridge-1.2.0-rc.9/dist/tokens.json
tool_input.description: Create branch and copy token files

tool_input.command: sed -i "s/import type { CSSProperties, ReactNode } from 'react';/import type { CSSProperties, HTMLAttributes, ReactNode } from 'react';/; s/React\.HTMLAttributes/HTMLAttributes/g" src/components/Chrome.tsx && grep -n "HTMLAttributes" src/components/Chrome.tsx
tool_input.description: Fix React type imports in Chrome.tsx
